architecture.name: Hierarchical Multi-Agent AI Team
architecture.communication: MCP Trigger + MCP Client Tool nodes
architecture.mcp_db_fix: npx n8n-mcp init or set N8N_MCP_DATA_DIR=/tmp/n8n-mcp/data and fs.cpSync from bundled node_modules
architecture.claude_builder_comparison: Claude Builder is Level-1-only flat agent creation. This architecture is 4 levels deep with 480,000x more granularity.

level_1_primary_agents.name: purchase-tracker
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Monitors Gmail via Gmail API or IMAP for purchases, invoices, receipts, payment confirmations
level_1_primary_agents.trigger: Gmail trigger node polling every 5 minutes

level_1_primary_agents.name: data-archiver
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Stores extracted data in structured archive organized by year, month, vendor with deduplication

level_1_primary_agents.name: comms-manager
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Central communication hub for email, Slack, Telegram, Discord

level_1_primary_agents.name: research-agent
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Web research, competitor analysis, market intelligence

level_1_primary_agents.name: content-pipeline
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Generates blog posts, social media content, newsletters, marketing copy

level_1_primary_agents.name: sales-crm
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Lead management, follow-ups, deal pipeline, pipeline reports

level_1_primary_agents.name: support-triage
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Customer support ticket categorization by urgency and topic, routing to handler

level_1_primary_agents.name: financial-ops
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Expense tracking, budget monitoring, invoice matching, spending alerts

level_1_primary_agents.name: devops-monitor
level_1_primary_agents.desc: GitHub repository watching, deployment pipeline monitoring, uptime and incident tracking

level_1_primary_agents.name: knowledge-base
level_1_primary_agents.desc: Documentation, wikis, SOP management by aggregating outputs from all other agents

error_handling.step_1: Check if N8N_MCP_DATA_DIR is set, default to /tmp/n8n-mcp/data
error_handling.step_2: Code node: fs.existsSync on all 3 known paths, log results
error_handling.step_3: npx n8n-mcp init or fs.cpSync from bundled node_modules

retry.backoff: exponential starting at 2s doubling to 30s max

error_handling.escalation: Call escalation webhook with trace ID, agent name, node, stack trace → comms-manager notifies admin

level_3_sub_agents.input_schema: JSON with required and optional fields
level_3_sub_agents.output_schema: JSON with confidence scores for extracted values
level_3_sub_agents.error_malformed_input: Return structured error object, never crash or hang

retry.backoff: exponential starting at 1s doubling to 5s max

deployment_recovery.aws_lambda: Copy from /var/task/node_modules/n8n-mcp/data to /tmp/n8n-mcp/data at cold start
deployment_recovery.google_cloud_run: Initialize in Dockerfile CMD or ENTRYPOINT

operations: single-character sanitization (Unicode, zero-width spaces, control chars)
date-format validation (ISO 8601, RFC 2822, US, European, Japanese, Chinese)
currency symbol detection (150 major and minor currencies)
vendor name fuzzy matching (Levenshtein distance at configurable thresholds)
confidence scoring (OCR quality, field completeness, consistency, historical accuracy)
level_4_mini_sub_agents.thundering_herd_prevention: First mini sub-agent reports error upward → parent runs self-healing → subsequent agents pause via Wait node with 5s polling interval → MCP_READY signal broadcast through static data store
level_4_mini_sub_agents.retry_policy: stateless and idempotent, safe to retry and scale horizontally

purchase_tracking_pipeline.trigger: Gmail trigger node polling every 5 minutes
flow: receipt-extractor orchestrates 40 sub-agents each with 60 mini sub-agents
OCR parsing, line-item splitting, date normalization
Validated data flows up to data-archiver (primary)

storage.google_sheets: Separate tabs per year, columns: date, vendor, amount, category, payment method, status
storage.sqlite: Full-text search via FTS5 indexes on vendor name, category, notes

deduplication.action_on_match: Merge or silently discard based on config

needs_review.trigger: Extraction confidence below 50% or cross-field validation errors
needs_review.action: Route to needs-review sheet + Telegram notification to admin with Google Sheets link

feedback_loop.process: Compare corrected extraction vs original AI extraction → adjust confidence weighting for that vendor and document type
feedback_loop.result: Continuous improvement without manual prompt engineering
